Setting up the board

Done

Your board has 11 tiles and the fixed Other… tile.

Hold and drag a tile to move it.

Tap a tile to change its error type. A type that is already on the board swaps places.

Tap + on an empty place to fill it, or choose New error type… to make one.

Types that are not on the board are under Other… on the Log screen.

The guide opens in your browser. This help works without a connection.
